resources.string: Ash
Ash phone control
Enable screen-off listening
Ash listens on this phone until turned off or stopped by Android. Wake detection stays on your phone and can use extra battery. Turn it off from Ash or the notification.
Allow Ash notifications to use screen-off listening. You can still tap Talk.
Download the wake and speech models in Settings first. You can still tap Talk.
Android could not start the microphone. Check microphone access and try again.
Voice assistant active
Listening for Hey Ash or Hello Ash
Microphone opening or paused
Listening reminders
Open Ash to enable screen-off listening again.
Choose default digital assistant
Ash is the active assistant
In Android Settings, open Apps → Default apps → Digital assistant to select Ash.
Ash is preparing to listen
Unlock your phone if needed, then open Ash and tap Talk.
Optional: choose media-session access
Android grants notification access to allow Ash to find and control supported media players. Ash does not read notification contents.
Secure storage is unavailable. Unlock your phone and try again; the key was not saved.
Connection failed. Check the provider URL, credentials and network.
Use Bluetooth earbud mic
Uses a connected Bluetooth headset microphone during voice commands and returns to hi-fi playback for replies. Standby wake detection uses the phone microphone.
Headset button fallback
Optional for earbuds without a digital-assistant gesture. Only active while no music is playing; never hijacks active playback.
